summary: REPRODUCED at exact candidate head fb8b5ea94f4ebc552e3bbafc6de8b2864b7fbb8a (fork branch lucene-pr14775-custom-comparator-probe on nick-boss-tech/lucene), parent 24e5430ed5675b53e74c6db6b5745fb49adc659d. The live apache/lucene PR 14775 head was verified equal to that parent (24e5430ed5675b53e74c6db6b5745fb49adc659d, ref reverse-sort, open) before the run and again at filing; no movement. Candidate scope confirmed: the head changes only lucene/core/src/test/org/apache/lucene/search/TestSort.java (+34 lines, one new test method) and no production code. Environment: normal isolated clean Linux clone, clean git status, Gradle 8.14 (the version the candidate's wrapper properties name), Eclipse Adoptium JDK 24.0.2 (the build requires at least Java 24; its Gradle cannot run on Java 25), builds serialized under the host lock. Host setup notes: GRADLE_USER_HOME had to point at the proxy-configured user home and the combined Hatch CA truststore was supplied, or plugin resolution failed; three setup attempts failed on those environment points and are recorded in the run history, not as candidate results. RUN: gradle :lucene:core:test --tests org.apache.lucene.search.TestSort.testInverseRetainsOverriddenComparator -Ptests.seed=5108C0DE -Ptests.rerun=true, exit 1, fresh JUnit XML: 1 test, 1 failure, 0 errors, 0 skipped. RESULT: the forward assertions passed (the search with the custom SortField, whose getComparator is overridden to compare by the 'actual' field, returned B then A as required), and the inverse assertion failed exactly as hypothesized: at TestSort.java line 87, org.junit.ComparisonFailure expected:<A> but was:<B>. The inverse therefore did not retain the overridden comparator: instead of reversing the 'actual' order to A,B, sort.inverse() returned B,A, the order produced by the nominal field the SortField names (descending nominal: B=2 before A=1). This is a behavioral reproduction on the Lucene API at the PR 14775 head, not a compile or setup error, and per the verdict policy it is a successful reproduction; it is not a green product test. DISTINCTION: this result concerns the Lucene inverseSort behavior only. Solr PR 5108 does not use this API; it implements reversal with its own SortSpec.ReverseSortField wrapper (verified separately in the PR 5108 integration gate at 918e579155). The open design questions on PR 14775 (tie-breaking and searchBefore/paging semantics) are untouched by this probe. No production patch, PR, issue, or public comment was made.
